Old Delhi, 2025

Documentary Feature

Meenapur,
Bihar

The Weight of Absence. Muzaffarpur District

In Meenapur, children play inside abandoned and damaged school structures while malnutrition, poverty, underpaid labour, and weak public systems quietly shape daily life. This reporting documents not only hunger, but the institutional absence surrounding it.

"The crisis here is not sudden. It is structural, repetitive, and normalised through neglect."

Field Notes

Families described irregular work, unstable food access, collapsing schools, and long-term economic distress.

Published Article. Jew Street, Fort Kochi

Field documentation and published reportage from Paradesi Synagogue Lane, Fort Kochi.

Documentary Reportage

Jew Street.
Fort Kochi.

Echoes of Trade and Memory. Kerala

Paradesi Synagogue Lane, Fort Kochi. One of the oldest surviving trade streets in India, where Jewish merchants once anchored Kerala's spice economy. Sarah Cohen, the last surviving member of the Paradesi Jewish community, lived here. Her portrait and the synagogue sign carry the whole story.

"Every face holds a contested history. The identity verification conundrum begins here."

Delhi After Dark

Winter Nights in the Capital

Fog, labour, sewage, silence, and survival merge into one urban atmosphere. People sleep on pavements beside open fire. A child stands behind iron bars. This is not the Delhi of monuments.

Manual Scavenging and Street Labour in Delhi

Workers break into Delhi's underground infrastructure with bare hands. No protective equipment. No oversight. This photograph is presented as evidence, not illustration. The state knows. The state permits.

Policy. Investigation

Wars Travel
Through Energy

The LPG Crisis in Delhi's Working Class Neighbourhoods

A man hauls gas cylinders through a narrow Delhi lane. At Rs 4000 a cylinder, geopolitical conflict lands on a kitchen shelf in Abul Fazal Enclave. Smaller menus. Unsold milk. Closed stalls. The invisible consequences of a distant war.

PolicyInvestigationField Report

Cylinder delivery outside a Delhi street shop. The economics of fuel are visible at every corner. Field photograph.

Coal fire in a Delhi lane. When LPG becomes unaffordable, older fuels return. Field photograph.

A Delhi restaurant at night. The cost of cooking has changed the cost of eating. Field photograph.

Visual Investigation. Ecology

The Land
Remembers

Kashmir Ecology. Manasbal Lake and the Scarred Hills

Power lines cut across a barren Kashmir hillside. An isolated structure sits at the edge of stripped land. Trucks pass through. The extraction is not hidden — it is normalised. The land holds evidence the official reports do not.

Visual InvestigationEcologyField Report

Rocky terrain above Manasbal Lake. The extraction leaves no green behind. Field photograph.

A dirt road cut through the hillside. The infrastructure of extraction. Field photograph.

Rubber Farmers

When the Market Broke the Village. Kerala

Collapsing rubber prices. Market manipulation. Agricultural communities exhausted by a system designed elsewhere and enforced here. The Kerala rubber economy unravelled quietly while policy looked the other way.

Human Rights Investigation. Media Accountability

Athar Hussain
Died Twice.

Died a week after the assault. Denied timely medical care.

NCRB data on Muslim lynching cases in India: the numbers exist. The accountability does not. Al-Falah school graduates fear a lifetime job blacklist from a media frenzy built on incomplete facts. Three investigations from Muslim Mirror document what mainstream coverage missed.
